findings.title: Caching tests were deleted although caching behaviour still exists
findings.body: The "Caching" describe block was removed from the tests. The service still caches results in `cachedAuthConditions` and `cachedFilterConditions` inside `getAuthorizationConditions` and `getFilterConditions`. Nothing in the converted suite now checks that a second call returns the cached value. Those tests only needed their expected values changed to `Prisma.sql`, not removal, so a regression in the cache logic would go unnoticed. Restore them with Sql-based expectations.
